notes:
Lead: Sunridge is a mid-market product company (analytics SaaS). Short notes / call fragments:
- Primary goal: replace brittle keyword search with semantic search for product docs + help center. Expect ~200 qps at peak, avg query latency target <150ms p50.
- Ingest profile: nightly batch ETL (02:00 UTC) creating ~300k vectors per job, monthly delta ~10M vectors. Concern: long-running batch windows and memory/throughput tuning.
- POC summary: used Hosted API for rapid iteration. Ingested 120k docs in POC bucket. Retrieval pipeline: embed -> FAISS (cloud-managed) for similarity -> re-rank with cross-encoder (optional). Observed: embed throughput ~6k vectors/min with current settings, planning to push to 15k/min on Dedicated.
- Vector DB: strong preference for cloud-native connector (managed Pinecone) but legal team pushing for PGVector (self-host) for residency/audit reasons. Need demonstration of Redwood integration with both.
- Model preferences: open-source embedding models preferred for cost; will accept Redwood-verified smaller models if latency/cost benefits clear. Interested in quantized inference on Dedicated.
- Metrics they care about: MRR/precision@5 on eval set, end-to-end p99 latency, monthly cost per 1M queries, time-to-complete nightly batch.
- Security/compliance: SSO/SAML mandatory, audit logs retention 1y, keys via KMS, EU residency for EU customers.
- Pricing: price sensitivity around per-vector ingestion costs and long-term committed capacity. Discussed two options: (a) Hosted + burst Dedicated for peak, (b) Reserved Dedicated monthly commit. Finance requests model-level cost projection vs current provider.
- Quote from CTO: "We need predictable economics for our vector pipeline — unknown per-vector bills are a blocker for procurement."
- Open items: final Dedicated sizing (GPUs + memory), connector stability report for PGVector, SSO test account, legal/data residency terms.
- Stubs/links: Fireflies ff link (FF-2026-03-02-7843), pricing sheet draft in Drive, POC log files uploaded to shared S3 (link shared in email thread).
- Sales notes: keep pressure on committed pricing — show clear break-even for 6/12 month commit. Highlight batching/kv-cache benefits and database connectors.
- Next milestone: run POC #2 (full nightly batch of 1.2M vectors) on Dedicated trial cluster, target run week of 2026-03-22.
short_description: Mid-market SaaS evaluating Redwood Hosted API for fast iteration then Dedicated for production. Focused on embeddings + semantic search: high-throughput nightly batch ingest, vector DB connector options, and committed pricing conversations.
